integrity: The proof is self-contained; finite exact tests support but do not replace the all-degree argument. Publication and independent external audit are not asserted.
scientific_limitations: Exact-degree harmonic spaces only; equal-time samples on one primitive periodic Hopf-torus curve. Nonnodal radius is required, with universal choice s=e^{-1}. No claim for mixed-degree bands, arbitrary curves, path-length minimization, or degree-uniform numerical conditioning. Historical priority not independently established.
title: Parity-sharp near-Nyquist recovery of exact three-sphere harmonics on one torus knot
